title: Knowledge-Embedded Hypergraph Neural Networks
authors: Yifan Feng, Yifan Zhang, Shaoyi Du, Shihui Ying, Zongze Wu, Yue Gao
affil: Tsinghua · Xi'an Jiaotong · Shanghai University · Shenzhen University
oneline: Conventional hypergraph networks only smooth features along relations. This paper computes two kinds of knowledge first — a structural ledger from hyperedge counts, a rule ledger from a boosted tree ensemble — fuses them, and only then runs the network.

title: End-to-End Game-Focused Learning of Adversary Behavior in Security Games
authors: Andrew Perrault, Bryan Wilder, Eric Ewing, Aditya Mate, Bistra Dilkina, Milind Tambe
oneline: Instead of predicting adversary behaviour accurately and hoping the decision follows, this paper trains the predictor on the decision it feeds — differentiating through the defender's optimisation so that the loss is the security outcome itself.
